cards.title: Status legend
items: candidate — named as the intended choice, not yet validated by real use
trial — being tried out in a limited, reversible way
adopted — in active use and the default choice for its role
hold — kept but no longer expanded; avoid new usage
foundation / external — nothing in this project sits below it

cards.title: Layers
items: Foundations — formats, runtimes, operating systems, external services, and host tools the project builds on
Shared — shared technologies used across channels
Product channels — Desktop (local-first Windows client), Mobile (Android capture and review), IDE (editor extensions), Cloud (Azure services)

cards.title: Reading the edges
items: Every edge points from a technology to what it sits on top of.
Foundations carry no outgoing edge: nothing in this project sits below them.
